description: This Java class 'BusinessStepConfigUpdateHandler' implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and is responsible for handling commands to update business step configurations within the application. It is annotated as a Spring service and handles transactional updates by delegating to a configuration service.

classes.name: BusinessStepConfigUpdateHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for business step configurations, applying transactional logic and delegating core update operations to a configuration service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a command to update business step configuration by invoking the configuration service, with error handling for specific business exceptions.
